title: 1949 green fireball meeting at Los Alamos

tellings.quote: his name is actually on a document from 1949 and it's this green fireball problem and it's him and Lincoln Leaz

plain: In 1949 a meeting at Los Alamos, the New Mexico nuclear weapons lab, took up what a document of the time calls the "green fireball problem", strange green lights reported in the sky, and the physicist Edward Teller's name is on that document along with the astronomer Lincoln LaPaz. Michels tells this himself, citing the conference document without quoting it. If it is true, some of the top weapons scientists of the day were drawn into the question.
